subject: Error in incprd file while performing steered molecular dynamics simulation

messages.author: Pinky Mazumder
messages.body:
Hi Amber Users,
I am trying to do steered molecular dynamics simulation between two
carbohydrates polymer to observe the shear phenomenon. There were two chain
parallel to each other. While I need to pull one chain towards a targeted
atom.
To do so, firstly, I have done the energy minimization with the following
input file given below:
Minimization with cartesian coordinates
&cntrl
imin=1, maxcyc=150000, ntmin=1,
ntb=1, ntc=1, ntf=1, irest=0, ntx=1,
tempi=298.0, temp0=298.0, dt=0.002, ig=-1,
ntr=1, restraintmask=':12-13', restraint_wt=10.0
ntwx=1000, ntpr=1000, ntwr=1000, ntxo=1, iwrap=1,
ioutfm=1,
/
And after that I have performed the steered molecular dynamics
simulation run using the file given below:
Sample pulling input
&cntrl
nstlim=150000, cut=10.0, igb=1, saltcon=0.1,
ntpr=100, ntwr=100000, ntt=1, ntb=1,
ntx=5, irest=1, ig=-1,
ntc=2, ntf=2, tol=0.000001,
dt=0.001, ntb=0, tempi=298.0, temp0=298.0,
ibelly=1,
bellymask=':1-2',
jar=1,
/
&wt type='DUMPFREQ', istep1=1, /
&wt type='END', /
DISANG=dist1.RST
DUMPAVE=dist1_vs_t
LISTIN=POUT
LISTOUT=POUT
